issue.title: Property cards become the note title block: one title, a clear species, and a docked rail on album, record, day, and period notes
issue.description: On desktop Obsidian, every album note, record note, canonical daily note, and week, quarter, and year note opens on its property card, and that card is the note's only visible title. The card leads with a species glyph tile and a kicker word (ALBUM, RECORD, DAY, WEEK, QUARTER, YEAR), so an album, a record, and a day can never be mistaken for each other, even in grayscale. The redundant H1, inline title, and nav line are hidden at render time, never deleted (except album H1s, which move into a bob-owned `title:` key). Every failure restores native rendering.

IDENTITY KIT API (bob-ledger-tools 1.144.0; all on module.exports.helpers via src/374-exports-property-card.js). Fragments 240f-240i after 240d. Species (240f): PROPERTY_CARD_KIND_ATTR ("data-card-kind"), PROPERTY_CARD_KINDS, propertyCardSpecies(kind) -> frozen {kind, word, tile, icon, band, temporal}, propertyCardAccessibleName(kind, title), propertyCardApplyIdentity(card, {kind, title}). Builders (240g): propertyCardBuildGlyphTile(doc, {kind, emoji?, icon?, band?, value?}) (leaf value carries data-value-length so CSS shrinks a 4-char year), propertyCardBuildTitleBlock(doc, {kind, title, kicker, pill, subtitle, tile, onLink}) -> {element, tile, kicker, heading, pill, subtitle, actions}, propertyCardBuildRail(doc, {prev, parent, next, children, label, onNavigate}) -> {element, items:{prev,parent,next}, children}. Links handle click and middle-click (auxclick button 1): preventDefault, then the injected handler with the raw event; never internal-link. Range and recognizers (240h, pure): propertyCardCleanInlineText, propertyCardCleanHeadingText, propertyCardTitleSourceRangeFromLines(lineAt, lineCount, recognizer), propertyCardTitleSourceRange(text, recognizer), propertyCardSelectionTouches(selection|state, range), propertyCardPeriodScaffoldTitle(subject) (bob labels.rs format), propertyCardAlbumTitleRecognizer(title), propertyCardDayTitleRecognizer(subject, {alias, today}), propertyCardPeriodTitleRecognizer(subject, {alias, today}). The period heading also accepts the bob scaffold title and the intention subject.label, not only the alias. Ownership (240i): PROPERTY_CARD_OWNS_TITLE_CLASS, PROPERTY_CARD_TITLE_SOURCE_CLASS, PROPERTY_CARD_TITLE_SOURCE_ATTR, propertyCardTitleScopeDenied, propertyCardTitleFieldCreate/Reduce/Decorations/Attributes, propertyCardTitleOwnershipExtension, propertyCardTitleEnsureEffect, propertyCardOwnTitleInEditor(view, {path, recognizer, defer?}), propertyCardReadingLineText, propertyCardOwnTitleInReading(scope, {path, recognizer}), propertyCardOwnTitle(scope, {path, recognizer, view}), propertyCardTitleReleaseAll, propertyCardHostRegisterTitleOwnership(plugin). Handles are release functions with .generation. Editor own returns null in Source mode and when the kit field is not installed (no host opted in), so adopters treat null as fall back to native. Re-owning the same path and key returns the same handle, and re-dispatches the same generation only if the field dropped it (Source round trip). Reading own bumps the generation on every call, like propertyCardOwnKeys, so keep the latest handle. Host: createPropertyCardHost({titleOwnership: true}) registers the field once per plugin (flag _propertyCardTitleOwnershipRegistered). Only opted-in hosts call propertyCardTitleReleaseAll on dispose. CSS: kit section at the end of styles.css. --bob-property-card-ink (accent 70% toward --text-normal) colors the species word, pill, and current chip so kicker contrast is at least 4.5:1. --bob-day-accent uses an rgb(0 191 188) fallback, not #00bfbc, because the Reading Board and Stats stylesheet contract tests forbid hex in trailing sections. The album header band applies only when content follows the title block (:not(:last-child)).

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: mixed-version album titles — an older bob derives album titles only from the H1, so (a) after the obsidian-proof apply removes H1s, and (b) for any album created by this bob (born with title: and no H1), an older bob running `bob albums sync` on another host (apollo, mac) rewrites walk lines and [!albums] catalog rows to the humanized stem. Upgrade every host that runs album sync before the live apply and before creating albums elsewhere; consider whether obsidian-proof should check host versions first.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: BOM-prefixed album notes are not albums — projects::parse_frontmatter requires line 1 to be exactly '---', so an album file that starts with a UTF-8 BOM is never registered and bob albums tidy/sync/list never see it. The tidy planner itself preserves BOM bytes (unit-tested), but album discovery would need to strip the BOM first. Pre-existing; no live album has a BOM today.
